question: Can one long-lived vLLM engine per GPU switch between Gold and candidate checkpoints (apply / reload / restore) without restart, with outputs bit-identical to a freshly started engine on the same weights?
source_commit_base: 2f641cc5960dc2293374914d7bd73db3ed104815 (plus the uncommitted harness files published in the same commit as this report)
population: configs/phaseD_v2/editor_population.json (12 patches: p50c/p25c/p10c upstream, 4 matched random directions, 3 random sparse, 1 random touching a fused tensor, 1 chained child of p50c)

engine.prefix_cache: enabled; reset after every transition and (round 2) before every generate()

hardware: 2x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24 GiB, driver 615.71.09, CUDA 13.0; GPU0 = direct sequence + extended cycles, GPU1 = restart reference + reload sequence

modes.direct: sparse BF16 index write into runtime parameter storage for checkpoint-identical tensors, sha256 before/after, rollback on mismatch; falls back to reload when a touched tensor is fused/transformed at load time
modes.reload: LLM.collective_rpc reload_weights from an exported candidate checkpoint directory

extended.round1: 74 random transitions, seed 1, greedy case only
extended.round2: 32 random transitions, seed 1, all three cases

cases.constrained: sampled + v1 structured outputs (choice / DSL regex)

metrics: per-request token-id hash identity versus the fresh-engine reference for the same state

rounds.round1: prefix cache reset only at transitions (warm cache between cases) -> raw files without prefix
rounds.round2: prefix cache reset before every generate() (prefix r2_)
